questions.question: A Brønsted-Lowry acid is defined as:
options: A substance that produces hydroxide ions in water

questions.question: A named shortcoming of the Arrhenius definitions is that they:
options: Cannot explain why ammonia, which contains no hydroxide, is a base

questions.question: When HCl dissolves in water, HCl + H₂O → H₃O⁺ + Cl⁻, the water acts as:
options: An acid, because it forms hydronium
A base, because it accepts the proton

questions.question: In NH₃ + H₂O ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻, ammonia is a base because it:
options: Produces hydroxide from its own formula

questions.question: A conjugate acid-base pair consists of two species that differ by:
In HCl + H₂O → H₃O⁺ + Cl⁻, the conjugate base of HCl is:
In NH₃ + H₂O ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻, the two conjugate pairs are:
H₂SO₄ and SO₄²⁻ are NOT a conjugate pair because they:
options: Differ by two protons instead of one

subtopics.title: Ampholytes, and the Three Reactions of Acids

questions.question: An ampholyte (amphiprotic substance) is one that can:
options: Dissolve in both water and oil
Act as a proton donor in one reaction and a proton acceptor in another
Change colour in acid and base

questions.question: Which pair of equations shows HCO₃⁻ acting as an ampholyte?
options: HCO₃⁻ + H₂O ⇌ CO₃²⁻ + H₃O⁺ and HCO₃⁻ + H₂O ⇌ H₂CO₃ + OH⁻
HCO₃⁻ → H⁺ + CO₃²⁻ and HCO₃⁻ → HCO₂⁻ + O²⁻
HCO₃⁻ + OH⁻ → CO₃²⁻ + H₂O written twice
HCO₃⁻ + H₃O⁺ → H₂CO₃ + H₂O written in both directions

questions.question: The products of an acid reacting with a metal carbonate are:
The balanced equation for hydrochloric acid reacting with magnesium oxide is:
Phenolphthalein is:
options: Colourless in acid and pink in base
Pink in acid and colourless in base
Red in acid and blue in base
Yellow in acid and blue in base

questions.question: The indicator with a distinct GREEN colour in neutral solution is:
Methyl orange in a basic solution is:
Acid is added drop by drop to a basic solution containing phenolphthalein. The moment the base is used up:
In the pass-the-ball picture, the acid is the player who:
Ammonia is a base even without hydroxide in its formula because it:
options: Is a good proton catcher, and even makes hydroxide from the water it robs

questions.question: To identify the acid in any equation, find the species that:
options: Loses an H going from left to right

subtopics.title: Partners Across the Pass, and the Player Who Plays Both Sides

questions.question: A conjugate pair is like the same player photographed:
options: Before and after the pass — with and without the proton
In both team jerseys at once

questions.question: Water can act as an acid or a base depending on:
options: The colour of the indicator added
What it reacts with — it catches from HCl but throws to NH₃

questions.question: "Show that HCO₃⁻ is an ampholyte" requires you to write:
options: Two equations — one where it donates a proton and one where it accepts one
One equation with a double arrow

subtopics.title: Three Fizzes and Four Colour Changes

questions.question: Which acid-base partner produces a fizz of gas?
options: A metal carbonate, which releases carbon dioxide

questions.question: Vinegar fizzing on baking soda, acid on a seashell and the school volcano are all examples of:
options: Acid + metal carbonate → salt + water + carbon dioxide

questions.question: During a neutralisation tracked with bromothymol blue, the colour sequence from basic to excess acid is:
Neutralisation produces water because:
options: Carbon dioxide reacts with the base
The acid's protons and the base's hydroxide combine as H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O
